content.short: Starch Industries provides mining software through Miner Token NFTs using a mix of on-chain and off-chain code.
content.description: Starch Industries provides mining software that users access through ownership of Miner Token NFTs. The project describes its stack as a mixture of on-chain and off-chain code, pairing token ownership with software access rather than treating the NFT as a simple collectible. Its positioning is experimental and infrastructure-oriented, with a focus on mining-related tooling built around Cardano-native assets.
